meta.name: datamol
meta.description: Pythonic wrapper around RDKit with simplified interface and sensible defaults. Preferred for standard drug discovery including SMILES parsing, standardization, descriptors, fingerprints, clustering, 3D conformers, parallel processing. Returns native rdkit.Chem.Mol objects. For advanced control or custom parameters, use rdkit directly.

copy.tagline: 简化药物发现中的分子数据处理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做药物发现或化学信息学，需要处理分子结构数据。
copy.tagline_en: Simplify molecular data processing in drug discovery
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work in drug discovery or cheminformatics and need to process molecular structures.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以用 Python 代码处理化学分子，比如解析 SMILES、计算描述符、生成指纹、聚类、生成 3D 构象等，所有操作都基于 RDKit 但更简单。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 处理化学分子数据（如 SMILES、SDF 文件），或进行药物发现相关的计算时触发。

say.text: 帮我计算这个 SMILES 的分子量和 LogP。
say.note: Claude 会调用 datamol 计算描述符。

say.text: 把这一批 SMILES 标准化并聚类。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can process chemical molecules using Python code, such as parsing SMILES, computing descriptors, generating fingerprints, clustering, and generating 3D conformers, all with a simplified RDKit interface.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to handle chemical molecular data (e.g., SMILES, SDF files) or perform drug discovery related computations.

say_en.text: Calculate molecular weight and LogP for this SMILES.
say_en.note: Claude will call datamol to compute descriptors.

say_en.text: Standardize and cluster this batch of SMILES.
say_en.note: Claude will use datamol for standardization and Butina clustering.
